Review_Title: FYI: How to Transfer foo Data from one device to another
Review_Text: FYI. I found a workaround to transfer foo DATA from one device to another. On your old device go to Support (toolbar icon) and Backup Database. Open a file manager such as Astro or Wi-Fi Explorer. Navigate to /storage/sdcard0/fooMoodTracker and copy the .db file to your desktop or wherever it's convenient. Next open a file manager on the new device. Navigate to storage/sdcard0/fooMoodTracker. If the directory doesn't exist then create it (case sensitive). Upload the .db file you just made. Open foo on the new device. Go to the support menu and import the database. There you go. They could have made this easier! Great app otherwise so 5 stars anyhow.
